title: Understanding Initial Weights
text: Think about how starting points in optimization problems can affect the path taken to reach a solution. Consider how different initial weights might lead to different paths in the gradient descent process.

title: Convergence in Gradient Descent
text: Consider what factors influence whether gradient descent converges to the optimal solution. What role do the learning rate and initial weights play in this process?

title: Impact of Initial Weights
text: Which of the following statements best describes the impact of initial weights on gradient descent?
choices: Initial weights are irrelevant in optimization
Initial weights determine the learning rate
Initial weights have no impact on convergence
